note: Legend portraits, the witch (Lead via Strategy, Dom 2026-09-27). One FLUX.1 [dev] text-to-image per rung, from the source text in src/legends.ts; never from a film, comic or game depiction. Final size 512x512. `style` is appended to every subject. The prompt is `framing` + `subject` + `style`.
framing: Close-up head-and-shoulders portrait, the face large and filling the upper half of the square frame, cropped at the chest, of
style: Dark painterly realism like an old oil painting, ancient brutal ceremonial tone, grounded proportions, muted palette of bronze, iron, bone, leather, stone and ash, a single low warm torchlight from one side leaving the rest in deep shadow, dark smoky near-black background, no saturated colours, no glowing effects, no text, no border, no frame.

legends.name: Hedge Witch
legends.subject: a village wise woman, a lined weathered face, grey hair under a wool shawl, bundles of herbs and roots in her hands, a low thatched cottage behind her.

legends.name: Mother Shipton
legends.subject: Mother Shipton the Yorkshire prophetess of the old chapbooks, a crooked old woman with a long hooked nose, a tall hat and shawl, a dripping cave behind her.

legends.name: Grimhild
legends.subject: Grimhild the sorceress queen of the Volsunga saga, a cold regal older woman with braided grey hair, a gold circlet, a drinking horn in her hand.

legends.name: Ceridwen
legends.subject: Ceridwen the Welsh enchantress, a wild-haired woman stirring a great iron cauldron over a fire, dark herbs and a cold stone hut behind her.

legends.name: Nimue
legends.subject: Nimue the Lady of the Lake, a pale young woman with long wet hair and a white robe, rising from misty dark water, a faint castle on the shore behind her.

legends.name: Louhi
legends.subject: Louhi the mistress of Pohjola from the Kalevala, a fierce old northern woman with wild grey hair, a fur mantle, a snowy frozen landscape behind her.

legends.name: Baba Yaga
legends.subject: Baba Yaga the witch of Slavic folklore, a bony old woman with iron teeth and a long nose, a headscarf, a hut on huge hen's legs in a dark forest behind her.

legends.name: Morgan le Fay
legends.subject: Morgan le Fay the enchantress of Arthurian legend, a beautiful dark-haired woman in a deep green gown, a silver circlet, a misty island of apple trees behind her.

legends.name: Merlin
legends.subject: Merlin the wizard of Arthurian legend, an old man with a long white beard and a hooded grey robe, deep knowing eyes, a standing stone circle behind him.

legends.name: Odin
legends.subject: Odin the All-Father of Norse myth, a one-eyed grey-bearded old man in a wide-brimmed hat and a blue-grey cloak, a spear, two ravens and a great ash tree behind him.
